This '''individual''' was appointed a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and given responsibility for the [[Morshdine sector/Legends|Morshdine sector]]. The Moff oversaw construction of an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] center on [[Tangrene]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the sector's [[Tangrene system/Legends|Tangrene system]]. Following completion of the Ubiqutorate center, the Moff ordered the [[Speciecide|genocide]] of its native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Tangrene (species)|Tangrene]], whom he had had [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] to help in the center's construction.
